batch: FTR-1109 known for: Adam, Eve, Jesus and God
first_reading: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Code agent): read the KJV verses (live API, read-only) and wrote the clauses with references, English and Ukrainian, after the pilot's method
second_reading: a separate claude-opus-5-5 agent with no part in the first reading: checked every clause against the KJV text of its cited verses; verdicts in raw/check.json

owner_rulings.text: «Також зроби для Адама та Єви також описи. І для Ісуса і для Бога, якшо не важко.»
no minor details; more than three clauses allowed but not overdone

current_summary.en: husband of Eve, father of Seth, Cain, Abel and other sons and daughters, ancestor of Jesus, David, Jacob, Moses and others
current_summary.uk: чоловік Єви, батько Сифа, Каїна, Авеля та інших синів і дочок, предок Ісуса, Давида, Якова, Мойсея та інших

known_for.en: was formed by God from the dust of the ground and put in the garden of Eden (GEN 2:7-8, 2:15); gave names to every living creature (GEN 2:19-20); ate from the tree God had forbidden him and was driven out of the garden (GEN 2:16-17, 3:6, 3:17-19, 3:22-24)
known_for.uk: був створений Богом із пороху землі й поселений у саду в Едені (GEN 2:7-8, 2:15); дав імена всім живим істотам (GEN 2:19-20); скуштував плоду з дерева, від якого Бог заборонив йому їсти, і був вигнаний із саду (GEN 2:16-17, 3:6, 3:17-19, 3:22-24)

clauses.en: was formed by God from the dust of the ground and put in the garden of Eden
clauses.uk: був створений Богом із пороху землі й поселений у саду в Едені

check.why: The English is right (GEN 2:7-8, 2:15) and keeps Adam as the implied subject in the passive. The Ukrainian switches to the active «Бог створив його», which makes God the subject of a clause in Adam's own line, unlike his other clauses («дав імена…», «скуштував…»). The passive matches the English and the line.

first.uk: Бог створив його з пороху землі й поселив у саду в Едені

clauses.en: gave names to every living creature

check.why: GEN 2:19 «whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof» and 2:20.

clauses.en: ate from the tree God had forbidden him and was driven out of the garden
clauses.uk: скуштував плоду з дерева, від якого Бог заборонив йому їсти, і був вигнаний із саду

check.why: The prohibition is GEN 2:16-17, the eating is 3:6 and 3:17, and the expulsion is 3:23-24. 3:18-19 and 3:22 add nothing the clause states, but they do no harm.

people.selection_note: The three clauses cover what a reader names. If a fourth is wanted, the one that is missing is his fatherhood: «fathered Cain, Abel and Seth» (GEN 4:1-2, 4:25, 5:3). That mirrors Eve's clause 3.

current_summary.en: wife of Adam, mother of Cain, Abel and Seth, ancestor of Jesus, David, Jacob, Moses and others
current_summary.uk: дружина Адама, мати Каїна, Авеля та Сифа, прамати Ісуса, Давида, Якова, Мойсея та інших

known_for.en: was made by God from a rib taken from Adam (GEN 2:21-23); was beguiled by the serpent, ate the fruit of the forbidden tree and gave it to Adam (GEN 3:1-6, 3:13); bore Cain, Abel and Seth (GEN 4:1-2, 4:25)
known_for.uk: була створена Богом із ребра, взятого в Адама (GEN 2:21-23); була спокушена змієм, скуштувала плоду забороненого дерева й дала його Адамові (GEN 3:1-6, 3:13); народила Каїна, Авеля і Сифа (GEN 4:1-2, 4:25)

clauses.en: was made by God from a rib taken from Adam
clauses.uk: була створена Богом із ребра, взятого в Адама

check.why: The English is right (GEN 2:21-22). The Ukrainian makes God the subject («Бог створив її») where the line's implied subject is Eve. The passive also carries the feminine agreement the rulings ask for.

first.uk: Бог створив її з ребра, взятого в Адама

clauses.en: was beguiled by the serpent, ate the fruit of the forbidden tree and gave it to Adam
clauses.uk: була спокушена змієм, скуштувала плоду забороненого дерева й дала його Адамові

check.why: GEN 3:6 (took, did eat, gave unto her husband) and 3:13 «The serpent beguiled me». «спокушена» matches Ogienko's «Змій спокусив мене» (3:13).

current_summary.en: prophet to Israelites, firstborn son of Mary, son of Joseph, brother of four brothers, descendant of David and Abraham, from Bethlehem, teacher of the Twelve and the Seventy
current_summary.uk: пророк ізраїльтян, первісток Марії, син Йосипа, брат чотирьох братів, нащадок Давида та Авраама, з Віфлеєма, учитель Дванадцятьох та Сімдесятьох

known_for.en: was born of the virgin Mary in Bethlehem (MAT 1:18-25, 2:1, LUK 1:26-27, 2:4-7); was baptized by John in the Jordan (MAT 3:13-17, MRK 1:9); preached the gospel of the kingdom and healed the sick (MAT 4:23, 9:35); was handed over by Pilate and crucified, died and was buried (MAT 27:24-26, 27:35, 27:50, 27:57-60, MRK 15:15); rose from the dead on the third day and was taken up into heaven (LUK 24:1-7, 24:46, 24:50-51, ACT 1:9-11)
known_for.uk: народився від діви Марії у Віфлеємі (MAT 1:18-25, 2:1, LUK 1:26-27, 2:4-7); охрестився від Івана в Йордані (MAT 3:13-17, MRK 1:9); проповідував Євангеліє Царства й уздоровляв хворих (MAT 4:23, 9:35); був виданий Пилатом і розп'ятий, помер і був похований (MAT 27:24-26, 27:35, 27:50, 27:57-60, MRK 15:15); на третій день воскрес із мертвих і був узятий на небо (LUK 24:1-7, 24:46, 24:50-51, ACT 1:9-11)

clauses.en: was born of the virgin Mary in Bethlehem
clauses.uk: народився від діви Марії у Віфлеємі

check.why: Virgin: LUK 1:27, MAT 1:23. Mary: MAT 1:18, LUK 1:27. Bethlehem: MAT 2:1, LUK 2:4-7.

clauses.en: was baptized by John in the Jordan

check.why: MAT 3:13 and 3:16 support it. MRK 1:9 «was baptized of John in Jordan» states the whole clause in one verse, and Ogienko's wording there is exactly the Ukrainian («охрестився від Івана в Йордані»). It is worth adding: MAT 3:13-17, MRK 1:9.

clauses.after_check: MRK 1:9 added, as the second reading suggested

clauses.en: preached the gospel of the kingdom and healed the sick
clauses.uk: проповідував Євангеліє Царства й уздоровляв хворих

clauses.en: was handed over by Pilate and crucified, died and was buried
clauses.uk: був виданий Пилатом і розп'ятий, помер і був похований

check.why: None of the cited verses names Pilate as the one who handed Jesus over. MAT 27:26 says only «he delivered him to be crucified», and Pilate is named as that «he» in MAT 27:24. MRK 15:15 names him in the same sentence: «Pilate… delivered Jesus… to be crucified».

clauses.en: rose from the dead on the third day and was taken up into heaven
clauses.uk: на третій день воскрес із мертвих і був узятий на небо

check.why: Risen: LUK 24:6. Third day: 24:7, 24:46. Taken up: 24:51, ACT 1:9-11.

people.selection_note: The five cover his life from birth to ascension. The clearest candidate for a sixth is «chose twelve apostles» (LUK 6:13, MRK 3:14). It is not required.

known_for.en: created the heaven and the earth, and made man in his own image (GEN 1:1, 1:26-27); brought the Flood upon the earth, then made a covenant with Noah never to send another (GEN 6:17, 7:17-23, 9:8-17); called Abraham and promised him a land and offspring as many as the stars (GEN 12:1-7, 15:5-7); brought Israel out of Egypt and gave them his law on Mount Sinai (EXO 12:51, 19:20, 20:1-17, 31:18); sent his only begotten Son into the world (JHN 3:16-17, 1JN 4:9)
known_for.uk: створив небо й землю, а людину — на свій образ (GEN 1:1, 1:26-27); навів на землю потоп, а потім уклав із Ноєм заповіт більше не наводити потопу (GEN 6:17, 7:17-23, 9:8-17); покликав Авраама й пообіцяв йому землю та нащадків, численних, як зорі (GEN 12:1-7, 15:5-7); вивів Ізраїля з Єгипту й дав йому свій Закон на горі Сінай (EXO 12:51, 19:20, 20:1-17, 31:18); послав у світ свого Однородженого Сина (JHN 3:16-17, 1JN 4:9)

clauses.en: created the heaven and the earth, and made man in his own image
clauses.uk: створив небо й землю, а людину — на свій образ

check.why: GEN 1:1, 1:27. The Ukrainian repeats «створив», which reads a little heavily. «створив небо й землю, а людину — на свій образ» would be smoother, but the current text is not wrong.

clauses.after_check: Ukrainian smoothed, as the second reading suggested

first.uk: створив небо й землю, а людину створив на свій образ

clauses.en: brought the Flood upon the earth, then made a covenant with Noah never to send another
clauses.uk: навів на землю потоп, а потім уклав із Ноєм заповіт більше не наводити потопу

check.why: GEN 6:17 «I, even I, do bring a flood», 9:9, 9:11 «neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth». «заповіт» is Ogienko's word for covenant.

clauses.after_check: shortened after the check for length; same verses, same sense

first.en: brought the Flood upon the earth, then made a covenant with Noah never again to destroy it by a flood
first.uk: навів на землю потоп, а потім уклав із Ноєм заповіт, що потоп більше не знищить її

clauses.en: called Abraham and promised him a land and offspring as many as the stars
clauses.uk: покликав Авраама й пообіцяв йому землю та нащадків, численних, як зорі

check.why: Call: GEN 12:1. Land: 12:7, 15:7. Stars: 15:5. The text names him Abram here, and Abraham is the site's name for him.

clauses.en: brought Israel out of Egypt and gave them his law on Mount Sinai
clauses.uk: вивів Ізраїля з Єгипту й дав йому свій Закон на горі Сінай

check.why: Out of Egypt: EXO 12:51, 20:2. The law: 20:1-17. On Sinai: 31:18. EXO 19:20 «the LORD came down upon mount Sinai» would tie the giving of the law at chapter 20 to Sinai more directly, but it is optional.

clauses.after_check: EXO 19:20 added, as the second reading suggested

clauses.en: sent his only begotten Son into the world
clauses.uk: послав у світ свого Однородженого Сина

check.why: 1JN 4:9 says it word for word, and Ogienko's wording there is «послав у світ Сина Свого Однородженого».

people.selection_note: For the record named YHVH, the one event missing is the giving of the name itself: «called Moses out of the burning bush and told him his name» (EXO 3:4, 3:13-15). Note that in EXO 3:2 it is «the angel of the LORD» who appears in the flame, while God calls from the bush in 3:4, so the actor has to be phrased as in this suggestion. This is the strongest candidate for a sixth clause.
